o1: Enables calmodulin-dependent protein phosphatase activity and protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity. Involved in embryonic body morphogenesis; male sex determination; masculinization of hermaphroditic germ-line; and nematode male tail tip morphogenesis. Is part of a protein-containing complex. Is expressed in dorsal/ventral epidermal cells. Is part of the embryonic elongation pathway, including the pak-1/fem-2 parallel elongation pathway. Orthologous to several human genes including PPM1F (protein phosphatase, Mg2+/Mn2+ dependent 1F).
